relations_to.summary: KFOR numbered 4,739 troops from 31 nations in June 2026; NATO announced on 12 Jun a gradual reduction toward 3,000-3,500 over the next year, reversible. KFOR is the actual shield and controls Kosovo's airspace under UNSCR 1244.

sources.title: KFOR Placemat, June 2026
NATO to cut troop numbers in Kosovo amid improved security situation

relations_to.summary: NATO announced on 12 Jun 2026 a gradual KFOR reduction toward 3,000-3,500 troops (back to 2023 levels), reversible and coordinated with troop rotations; KFOR will keep supporting the EU-led dialogue.
